units.source_text: 桐壶院也很悲伤，郑重地遣使吊唁。

en.t: The Kiritsubo Emperor was also deeply saddened and solemnly sent an envoy to offer condolences.

units.source_text: 家中虽遭不幸，反而因此增加光彩，悲哀之中平添了欢喜。

en.t: Although the household had suffered misfortune, this instead added to its honor, and joy was mingled with grief.

units.source_text: 左大臣感激之余，流泪不绝。

en.t: The Minister of the Left was so moved with gratitude that his tears would not stop flowing.

units.source_text: 他听从别人的劝告，为祈求女儿复活而举行庄严隆重的法事，又历尽无遗地施行种种救活的办法。

en.t: Following the advice of others, he held solemn and magnificent Buddhist rites to pray for his daughter's return to life, and he tried every possible means of reviving her.

units.source_text: 然而眼见得尸体已经腐烂，父母虽然痴心妄想地盼望，终不过是毫无希望地度日。

en.t: Yet as they saw plainly that the body had already begun to decay, the parents, though clinging to a foolish hope, could only pass the days without any real hope at all.

units.source_text: 到了无可奈何之时，只得将遗骸送往鸟边野火葬场去。

en.t: When there was no longer anything to be done, they had no choice but to send the remains to the cremation ground at Toribeno.
The sorrow of it cannot be fully described.
